verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a business financial platform, so earning yield on operating balances is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions yield, interest, or any treasury or investment product. Holding multi-currency balances, interbank FX rates and card cashback are adjacent features that do not earn yield on cash.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can earn yield on operating cash balances without moving funds to a separate institution
